title: Cracked Soccer Ball Bong
description: A large cracked white soccer ball with glowing cyan edges sits on a wooden table, its center broken open to reveal a dark castle silhouette. A colorful glass bong shaped like a paw print pipe emerges from the top, surrounded by vibrant swirling vines, dragonflies, flowers, and black paw prints scattered across the table.
